svg.title: Player one: luchub-19
svg.desc: Player one: a desk by a window over Ocean Drive at dusk. A laptop runs a dev server, a coffee steams, a note reads 'One more commit.', a sticker reads 'Works on my machine.' Writes C++ and TypeScript. Public work: a raylib shooter, a hangout planner, a SwayFX desktop with a hand-written shell, and a study platform for data structures.
